Also NO_GO on high PCI DSS (40) and Internal Governance (45) risk for a card-data + auth change.
- **Other stories carry conditions, not clean GO**: ST-112 confidence 49 (security 73 high, GDPR/Internal Governance medium, collision with ST-107), ST-101 confidence 54, ST-104 confidence 58. Only ST-115 is a plain GO (confidence 94).

Net: the sprint's low confidence is driven by the ST-107 NO_GO plus pervasive conditional decisions, cross-story deployment collisions, and high compliance/security factors on card, auth and PII components — not by a single factor.
